name: AMCL
description: Adaptive Monte Carlo Localization for a mobile robot. Uses particle filter to estimate robot pose.

name: GMapping
description: Gmapping is a ROS wrapper for OpenSlam's GMapping. Creates 2D occupancy grid maps from laser data.

name: Cartographer
description: Google’s real-time SLAM library for 2D/3D mapping and localization. Takes input from LiDAR, IMU, odometry, etc., and produces consistent maps.

name: SICK Scan Driver
description: Driver for SICK TIM series laser scanners. Provides laser scan data for navigation and mapping.

name: Velodyne Driver
description: Driver for Velodyne 3D LiDAR scanners. Provides point cloud data for 3D perception.

name: IMU Driver
description: Driver for Inertial Measurement Unit sensors. Provides orientation and angular velocity data.

name: Move Base
description: Navigation stack for mobile robots. Combines global and local path planning with obstacle avoidance.

name: Global Planner
description: Global path planning component. Calculates optimal path from current position to goal.

name: Local Planner
description: Local path planning and obstacle avoidance. Generates velocity commands for robot movement.

name: Navigation2
description: The ROS2 successor to the navigation stack. Nav2 provides perception, planning, and control modules (using behavior trees) for autonomous navigation.

name: Base Controller
description: Low-level controller for mobile robot base. Converts velocity commands to motor signals.

name: Joint Controller
description: Controller for individual robot joints. Manages position, velocity, and effort control.

name: ros_control
description: A set of controller frameworks and hardware interfaces for actuator control. Standardizes how joint and sensor data are handled.

name: Object Detection
description: Computer vision-based object detection and recognition. Identifies objects in camera images.

name: Point Cloud Processor
description: Processes 3D point cloud data for filtering, segmentation, and feature extraction.

name: SLAM Processor
description: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping processor. Builds maps while localizing the robot.

name: PCL ROS
description: The ROS interface to the PCL library for 3D point-cloud processing. Includes tools to convert, filter, and segment LiDAR or depth-camera clouds.

name: OctoMap Server
description: A 3D occupancy-mapping system using octrees. The octomap_server node builds and publishes a volumetric map from point cloud input.

name: robot_localization
description: A collection of state estimation nodes for ROS that provides sensor fusion for localization and mapping. Includes Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) and Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) implementations.

name: Hector SLAM
description: A flexible and scalable SLAM approach that does not require odometry. Uses high update rate 2D range scan matching and provides 2D pose estimates at scan rate.

name: ORB_SLAM2
description: A real-time SLAM library for monocular, stereo and RGB-D cameras that computes the camera trajectory and a sparse 3D reconstruction in real-time.

name: realsense-ros
description: ROS drivers for Intel RealSense cameras including D400, L500, and T265 series. Provides RGB, depth, and IMU data streams with configurable parameters.

name: flir_camera_driver
description: ROS driver for FLIR thermal and visible cameras using the Spinnaker SDK. Supports various FLIR camera models with configurable exposure, gain, and frame rate settings.

name: ublox_gps
description: ROS driver for u-blox GPS receivers. Provides GNSS positioning data, supports RTK corrections, and includes configuration utilities for various u-blox modules.

name: TEB Local Planner
description: A local trajectory planner that optimizes the robot's trajectory with respect to trajectory execution time, separation from obstacles, and compliance with kinodynamic constraints.

name: Smac Planner
description: A hybrid A* planner for Nav2 that creates kinematically feasible paths for differential drive and car-like robots. Supports lattice-based and hybrid approaches.

name: RRT* Planner
description: An asymptotically optimal rapidly-exploring random tree planner. Provides probabilistically complete and asymptotically optimal path planning in complex environments.

name: darknet_ros (YOLO)
description: Real-time object detection using YOLO (You Only Look Once) neural networks. Detects multiple object classes in images with bounding boxes and confidence scores.

name: apriltag_ros
description: A ROS wrapper for the AprilTag visual fiducial detection system. Detects AprilTag markers in images and provides their 6DOF poses for localization and navigation.

name: laser_filters
description: A collection of filters for processing laser scan data. Includes filters for removing spurious readings, angular bounds, intensity filtering, and temporal smoothing.
